 Juvenile in custody after fatal weekend assault in Hartford
 Law enforcement confirmed Monday that the suspect is a juvenile, and declined to release additional information.
 A Minnehaha County Sheriff's Office squad car sits parked. Contributed / Minnehaha County Sheriff's Office 
 By 
 Hunter Dunteman 
 October 25, 2026 at 5:36 PM

 HARTFORD, S.D. — A juvenile is in police custody after an assault turned fatal in Hartford over the weekend.
 Shortly before 8:45 a.m. Sunday, Oct. 25, the Minnehaha County Sheriff’s Office was dispatched to the 800 block of Turtle Creek Drive in Hartford for a report of an assault.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 According to Sgt. Scott Dubbe, the victim of the assault was critically injured.
 Emergency medical personnel attempted life-saving measures, but the victim died as a result of their injuries.
 On Monday, Sgt. Zach Cegelske confirmed that a juvenile suspect had been taken into custody following the assault, and that the juvenile remained in custody as of midday Monday.
 South Dakota law precludes the release of certain information related to criminal proceedings against minors.
 "Because the individual involved is a minor and the case remains active, no additional information can be released at this time," Cegelske said.
 Additional information regarding the victim's identity has also not been released by authorities.
 "We appreciate the public’s patience and understanding as we work to protect the integrity
of the investigation and the privacy of those involved," Cegelske added.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 The sheriff’s office was assisted on scene by the South Dakota Highway Patrol, Avera Careflight and medical crews from Hartford Area Fire and Rescue and Humboldt Ambulance.
